The warnings recorded on a design or an estimate

Source: R/warning-record.R
get_warnings.Rd

Every warning tidycreel raises is also recorded on the object the call returns, so it can be read back after it has scrolled past. A design keeps the warnings raised by creel_design(), each add_*() step and adjust_nonresponse(); an estimate keeps the warnings raised while it was computed, including those from a rate a total computes internally.

Usage

get_warnings(x)

Arguments

x

A creel_design or a creel_estimates object.

Value

A data frame with one row per warning, in the order raised:

id

Position in the session's sequence of tidycreel warnings.

class

Its own class: creel_warning_<fact>, or for a tier-3 message creel_message_<fact>.

tier

1, 2 or 3, as above.

fn

The function that raised it.

message

The text of the warning or message, without formatting.

Zero rows when nothing was raised.

Details

Each warning has a tier, as listed in creel_warnings:

1

The estimate may be wrong: units, a missing period length, sections or cells left out of a total, an SE that ignores the design.

2

Data quality or precision: small samples, exclusions, short trips, thin cells.

3

Information: an argument with no effect, an estimator choice. Raised as a message, not a warning, and recorded all the same.

A warning is recorded even when the caller handles or muffles it. A data-quality warning (tier 2) prints only the first time it is raised on a design; its repeats are recorded here without printing (see creel_warnings). A first occurrence the caller muffles, with suppressWarnings() or a handler, still counts as that one print: later calls on the same design do not print it. Warnings raised by other packages (survey, lme4) are not recorded.

See also

creel_warnings for every class and its meaning.

Examples

design <- creel_design(example_calendar, date = date, strata = day_type)
design <- add_counts(design, example_counts)

# The party-size warning is handled for this one call, so it does not
# print, but the design still records it.
design <- withCallingHandlers(
  add_interviews(design, example_interviews,
    catch = catch_total, effort = hours_fished, trip_status = trip_status
  ),
  creel_warning_no_party_size = function(w) invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
)
#> ℹ Added 22 interviews: 17 complete (77%), 5 incomplete (23%)
get_warnings(design)
#>    id                       class tier             fn
#> 1 124 creel_warning_no_party_size    1 add_interviews
#>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    message
#> 1 ! No `n_anglers` provided — assuming 1 angler per interview.\nℹ Pass `n_anglers = <column>` to use actual party sizes for angler-hour\n  normalization.\nℹ If the interviews really are one angler each, pass `n_anglers = 1` to state\n  that and silence this warning.
